files.description: Club members, one per row (240 rows): member_id (whole number), full_name (first and last name; many names have accented letters; capital letters and spaces around the name are inconsistent), home_city (city name, several with accented letters; capital letters and spaces around the name are inconsistent; about 3% of cells are empty and about 3% hold "-" for an unknown city), fee (yearly fee, two decimals).

task_text: How many members pay each yearly fee? There are only a few fee levels, so treat the fee as a categorical label and show each fee exactly as it is written in the file, with both decimals (for example '104.50'). `result` should be a Series indexed by the fee text with the number of members.
intended_computation: Read fee as text, count the members per fee text (12 fee levels, 240 members) and index the counts by the fee exactly as written, e.g. '104.50'.

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.1 categories read from the file become numbers, so '104.50' turns into 104.5

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
